messages:
maya: quick RFC follow-up: proposing hybrid bucket + lease model for prefix cache eviction. want to avoid heavy handoffs.

maya: idea in 3 lines: buckets (hot/warm/cold) per-node + tiny strict write-lease for mutations. nodes demote based on bucket state, coordinator aggregates counts.

trent: how do we protect writes/cursors? leases?

maya: yes — 5-15s writer lease for any mutating or long-lived cursor ops. demote must consult active leases and defer.

arjun: impl note: slab allocator already tracks age. I'll add an adapter to map slab hotness -> bucket and a demote API: POST /v1/prefix/{id}/demote?stage=soft|compact|evict which returns {ok, eta_ms}.

sasha: telemetry plan: piggyback bucket tag on existing request beacon. emit per-node hist every 5s. add dashboard rows: bucket-dist, demote-aborts, rehydrate-rate.

maya: mitigation for spikes: staged eviction + tiny prefill sketch that helps short rehydrates.

trent: test plan: 1% canary flag, measure cross-node handoffs, p99 read latency, demote-abort rate. add failure injection where coordinator pauses 10s.

arjun: I'll prototype adapter + minimal API surface.

sasha: will add metrics panel and alert for rehydrate spike.

maya: decision: 4-week spike. success criteria: >=15% fewer handoffs and <5% p99 regression. owners: arjun, sasha, trent. :thumbsup:

trent: ack.

arjun: starting branch.

sasha: noted.
